correctness.rationale: For every n>=8, add exactly the chords {n,2^j} with j>=1 and 2^j<=n-2, i.e. floor(log2(n-2)) edges. Define suffix sums S_t=sum_{i=t}^n i with S_(t-1)-S_t=t-1. Targets 1..n-1 are singleton labels; T_n is all vertices. Each remaining target k is in unique interval S_t<=k<S_(t-1), 2<=t<=n; residue r=k-S_t is in 0..t-2. Expand r in distinct powers of two, each smaller than t, and attach those corresponding vertices to the suffix. Bit 1 attaches to n via the original C_n edge and bit 2^j>=2 attaches via a new chord. The induced set is connected and its sum exactly k. This proves the unrestricted logarithmic upper bound without algorithm execution. Independently generated and BFS-checked 4,876 target witnesses across n8..30 against chord graph; read actual verifier implementing a related finite check. No matching lower bound or exact minimum asserted.
